newsitem.title: FRANCE: Tipsy French cook in soup after bomb hoax.
newsitem.headline: Tipsy French cook in soup after bomb hoax.

text.p: A drunken French cook who raised a false bomb alarm in a call to police after hearing news of a Paris train explosion this week was jailed for two months om Thursday, justice sources said.
The cook, 47, watched television reports of Tuesday's blast while at home in Hellemes, northern France, and called the local police station saying a bomb was about to explode in 20 minutes.
The sources said police identified the caller, who was afrrested and tried by a court in Lille.
Tuesday's bomb on a Paris commuter train killed two people and injured many others.
